description: The mAIEnergy team deposits a European-focused multimodal energy corpus on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Its own metadata describes about 50,000 texts, 20,000 images, 25 million numerical time-series records and 2 million geospatial or relational entries, grouped into text, numerical, spatial and image modules. The numerical and spatial components may supply observations and asset context for energy-system modelling; a modeller could extract them for a network-capacity workflow with model-pypsa. The archive’s main stated purpose is language-model pretraining and retrieval, so it is not a ready-made simulation case or validated network. Its many upstream sources carry their own licences and provenance; the top-level CC BY label should not be read as a grant for every reused input. Temporal coverage varies by source. I read the own Zenodo metadata and manifest, without downloading the archive, examining the schema of each module, testing numerical quality or using the corpus for model training.
